description: Implement 100 advanced algorithms for portfolio optimization and risk management. Each algorithm is a Python class extending the Algorithm base class with an optimize() method. Categories: Portfolio Optimization (20), Risk Management (15), Asset Allocation (15), Signal Processing (10), Statistical Methods (15), Numerical Methods (10), Machine Learning Optimization (15).
steps: Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/optimization/__init__.py and implement 20 portfolio optimization algorithms: (1) mean_variance.py - Markowitz mean-variance, (2) min_variance.py - global minimum variance, (3) max_sharpe.py - maximum Sharpe ratio, (4) risk_parity.py - risk parity/equal risk contribution, (5) black_litterman.py - Black-Litterman model, (6) hierarchical_risk_parity.py - HRP clustering-based, (7) max_diversification.py - maximum diversification ratio, (8) robust_optimization.py - robust mean-variance with uncertainty sets, (9) cvar_optimization.py - CVaR (conditional VaR) optimization, (10) omega_ratio.py - Omega ratio maximization, (11) kelly_criterion.py - Kelly criterion sizing, (12) resampled_efficient_frontier.py - Michaud resampled frontier, (13) inverse_variance.py - inverse variance weighting, (14) equal_weight.py - 1/N equal weighting, (15) most_diversified.py - most diversified portfolio, (16) minimum_cvar.py - minimum CVaR portfolio, (17) target_return.py - target return optimization, (18) factor_risk_parity.py - factor-based risk parity, (19) tail_risk_parity.py - tail-risk parity, (20) entropy_pooling.py - Meucci entropy pooling

Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/risk/__init__.py and implement 15 risk management algorithms: (1) var_historical.py - historical VaR, (2) var_parametric.py - parametric/Gaussian VaR, (3) var_monte_carlo.py - Monte Carlo VaR, (4) cvar_calculation.py - Expected Shortfall/CVaR, (5) stress_testing.py - scenario stress testing, (6) drawdown_control.py - max drawdown control, (7) position_sizing.py - optimal position sizing, (8) stop_loss.py - dynamic stop-loss algorithms, (9) correlation_regime.py - correlation regime detection, (10) tail_risk.py - tail risk measurement (EVT), (11) risk_budgeting.py - risk budgeting across assets, (12) marginal_risk.py - marginal risk contribution, (13) factor_risk_decomposition.py - factor risk decomposition, (14) liquidity_risk.py - liquidity-adjusted risk, (15) concentration_risk.py - portfolio concentration measures

Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/allocation/__init__.py and implement 15 asset allocation algorithms: (1) strategic_allocation.py - long-term strategic weights, (2) tactical_allocation.py - short-term tactical tilts, (3) dynamic_allocation.py - time-varying allocation, (4) constant_proportion.py - CPPI constant proportion, (5) target_date.py - lifecycle/glide path, (6) momentum_allocation.py - momentum-based allocation, (7) risk_on_off.py - risk-on/risk-off regime, (8) min_correlation.py - minimum correlation allocation, (9) max_decorrelation.py - maximum decorrelation, (10) core_satellite.py - core-satellite approach, (11) liability_driven.py - liability-driven investment, (12) goal_based.py - goal-based allocation, (13) regime_based_allocation.py - regime-conditional allocation, (14) volatility_weighted.py - vol-weighted allocation, (15) drawdown_based.py - drawdown-based dynamic allocation

Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/signal_processing/__init__.py and implement 10 signal processing algorithms: (1) kalman_filter.py - Kalman filter for signal extraction, (2) wavelet_transform.py - wavelet denoising, (3) fourier_analysis.py - FFT frequency decomposition, (4) hodrick_prescott.py - HP filter trend extraction, (5) savitzky_golay.py - Savitzky-Golay smoothing, (6) exponential_smoothing.py - Holt-Winters smoothing, (7) bandpass_filter.py - bandpass signal filtering, (8) hilbert_transform.py - Hilbert transform instantaneous phase, (9) emd_decomposition.py - Empirical Mode Decomposition, (10) particle_filter.py - particle filter state estimation

Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/statistical/__init__.py and implement 15 statistical algorithms: (1) covariance_estimation.py - sample/shrinkage covariance (Ledoit-Wolf), (2) pca_decomposition.py - PCA for factor extraction, (3) independent_component.py - ICA for signal separation, (4) bayesian_estimation.py - Bayesian parameter estimation, (5) bootstrap_methods.py - bootstrap confidence intervals, (6) copula_modeling.py - copula dependence modeling, (7) regime_detection.py - Hidden Markov Model regimes, (8) changepoint_detection.py - structural break detection, (9) density_estimation.py - kernel density estimation, (10) extreme_value.py - extreme value theory/EVT, (11) robust_statistics.py - robust estimators (MAD, Huber), (12) time_series_decomposition.py - STL/seasonal decomposition, (13) granger_causality.py - Granger causality testing, (14) dynamic_correlation.py - DCC-GARCH dynamic correlations, (15) factor_analysis.py - statistical factor analysis

Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/numerical/__init__.py and implement 10 numerical algorithms: (1) gradient_descent.py - gradient descent optimizer, (2) newton_method.py - Newton's method, (3) simulated_annealing.py - simulated annealing, (4) genetic_algorithm.py - genetic algorithm optimization, (5) particle_swarm.py - particle swarm optimization, (6) differential_evolution.py - differential evolution, (7) quadratic_programming.py - QP solver wrapper, (8) linear_programming.py - LP for constraint handling, (9) monte_carlo_simulation.py - MC simulation engine, (10) convex_optimization.py - general convex optimization wrapper

Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/ml_optimization/__init__.py and implement 15 ML optimization algorithms: (1) neural_network_optimizer.py - simple neural net weight optimization, (2) reinforcement_learning.py - RL-based allocation (Q-learning), (3) bayesian_optimization.py - Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, (4) online_learning.py - online/incremental learning, (5) transfer_learning.py - domain adaptation for allocation, (6) attention_weighting.py - attention mechanism for asset weighting, (7) autoencoder_features.py - autoencoder feature extraction, (8) clustering_allocation.py - cluster-based allocation, (9) manifold_learning.py - manifold-based dimensionality reduction, (10) graph_based.py - graph/network-based allocation, (11) meta_learning.py - meta-learning across market regimes, (12) multi_objective.py - multi-objective optimization (Pareto), (13) adversarial_robustness.py - adversarial robustness in optimization, (14) variational_inference.py - variational inference for uncertainty, (15) gaussian_process.py - GP regression for return prediction
Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/registry.py - auto-discovery that imports all algorithm classes and registers them, providing list_algorithms() and get_algorithm(name) functions

Create tests/test_algorithms.py - test that all 100 algorithms can be instantiated and optimize() returns valid weight arrays that sum to approximately 1.0 (or satisfy stated constraints) on sample return data
acceptance_criteria: All 100 algorithm classes exist and are importable
Each algorithm extends the Algorithm base class and implements optimize()
from quant_portfolio.algorithms.registry import list_algorithms; assert len(list_algorithms()) >= 100
pytest tests/test_algorithms.py passes - all algorithms produce valid weight vectors
Each algorithm has a docstring explaining its mathematical approach and parameters
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/portforlio_construction && python -c 'from quant_portfolio.algorithms.registry import list_algorithms; algos = list_algorithms(); print(f"Total algorithms: {len(algos)}"); assert len(algos) >= 100'
findings: All 100 algorithms implemented across 7 categories. All 204 tests pass in 2s. Uses scipy.optimize, numpy.linalg, and scipy.stats. No external ML libraries needed for core logic. Auto-registration via __init_subclass__ works seamlessly. Full test suite (245 tests) passes.
